item.description:
• File compare: choose two open files via Features → Compare Files (⌥⌘D) or the sidebar context menu; side-by-side view with synced scrolling highlights changed (with inline differences), deleted and added lines, with previous/next difference navigation
  • With no selection, ⌘C / ⌘X copy or cut the whole current line, and ⌘V pastes it above the current line

• 文件对比：功能菜单「文件对比」或 ⌥⌘D 选择两份已打开的文件，也可在侧边栏右键「与当前文件对比」；左右两栏对齐显示、滚动联动，标出修改（含行内差异）、删除、新增的行，可跳到上一处 / 下一处差异
  • 无选中时 ⌘C / ⌘X 复制或剪切光标所在整行，⌘V 粘贴到当前行之前
